title: cp-gov-uk-notify-gateway send-email-notification
description: MVP inbound ASB command contract consumed by cp-gov-uk-notify-gateway (the SendEmailCommand body on the ng-send-email command queue). Ported from the legacy cpp-context-notification-notify command schema — see command-send-email-notification-legacy.schema.json for the legacy contract to diff against. Delta from legacy: the legacy fileId attachment reference is replaced by fileUri (the Azure Blob URI resolved by the attachment downloader, FR-004); materialUrl is supported as in legacy (same name and type) - a Material document link the gateway resolves onto the Material service and downloads through Material; a non-blank materialUrl takes precedence over fileUri, and a blank one counts as absent; the required set (notificationId, templateId, sendToAddress) is unchanged. The inbound ASB ReplyTo message property (captured into notification.result_queue, NG-S03) and correlationId travel in the message envelope, not this body. Additive-only evolution.
